note: Checked from the research environment. Container network access and the page-fetch tool were both tested; web search ran through the search tool.

sources.note: Returns current US results with links and summaries. The initial research used the full 200-search session budget.
Blocked by the environment network policy for nearly every publisher tried (Fortune, Yahoo, Fast Company, The Verge, Pinterest newsroom, Gelato, others).
trends.google.com denied by network policy. No relative-interest series could be measured.
reddit.com denied by network policy; Reddit evidence appears only via search results.
etsy.com and openapi.etsy.com denied. Listing counts, sales and bestseller badges could not be observed.
pinterest.com denied. Pinterest figures come from its published reports as cited by search results.
tiktok.com denied. TikTok activity appears only via search results and press.
youtube.com denied; the Data API needs an API key that is not configured.
wikimedia.org denied. This would have provided absolute daily attention measurements for charts.
Denied; entries appear via search results only.
